greeting: Once, crowds cheered here. Now? Sand.
El Verde. I wrestled. I lost. I live.
The mask stays on. Don't ask why.
You want stories? I have stories. Most end with me losing.
El Scorcho rules now. As it should be.
Come to see where legends fell? Welcome.
dialog.shop_open: Selling old gear. Mementos. Pieces of a life that was.
dialog.shop_prompt: Autographed masks. Broken championship belts. My dignity. Cheap.
haggle: Price? Whatever. Nothing's worth what it was.
For a fellow fighter? Free. You're not a fighter? Still free.
purchase_success: Treat it better than I did.
It served me once. May it serve you.
purchase_fail: Changed your mind? Wise. Keep it.
Some things shouldn't be sold. Maybe this.
No matter. It stays with me.
rumor: El Scorcho? He was my student. Now he's the master. Circle of life.
The arena had real magic once. Before my time. Before the fall.
Barrelman Bob wrestled barrels before my first match. True story.
Deep-Dig Dan wants to wrestle a sand wyrm. Told him I'd referee.
dialog.quest_hook: Lost my final mask. The green one. Fell in the Scorched Wastes during... an incident. Bring it back? It's all I have left of the glory days.
dialog.quest_active: The green mask. Somewhere in the wastes. Please.
dialog.quest_complete: You found it. You actually... thank you. Here. My real championship belt. The one that mattered.
farewell: The mask is heavy. You'll learn.
dialog.time_noon: Hot. Like the lights used to be.
dialog.time_night: The arena ghosts wrestle at night. I hear them.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The mask-finder. My debt is eternal.
dialog.lament: Three-time champion. Then the knee. Then the fall. Then the sand.

party_reactions.kade: Sad story. Hope he finds peace.
party_reactions.nix7: Athletic career: terminated. Emotional damage: significant.
party_reactions.twist: Did you REALLY jump off the top rope? WOW!
party_reactions.renna: The tragedy of lost glory. Poetic.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face. In the ruins. Why?
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You return. To hear more? Or pity?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You understand loss. True loss. We're kin, you and I.

mini_quest.title: The Fallen Mask
mini_quest.description: Retrieve El Verde's lost wrestling mask from the Scorched Wastes

stages.hook: Lost my final mask in the wastes. During an... incident. Bring it back? All I have of the glory days.
stages.active: Scorched Wastes. Near the old dune field. Green mask. Can't miss it.
stages.complete: You found it. My... thank you. Take this. My real championship belt. The one that mattered. Before the show belts.
